about: Kneeling Crown (katana.k_2l5), the two-handed string's last hit (KE task 14): Attack2H02's overhead, its circling wind-up quickened (source frames 0-19.5 over 12) to the blade raised high behind the head, held at the top, then cut straight down to the ground, the hips dropped 30 cm into a kneel and held (Elden Ring's two-handed last hit kneels about 42 frames at 60 fps), then risen back to the guard. The clip is two-handed already: the left hand is set on the grip and the blade kept clear of the body. A step forward carries the body into the cut. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
